webpage.text:
Carolina Brewery

The Carolinas are calling. Who’s In?

For some of us, it’s rafting the Nantahala or sailing off Masonboro Island. For others, it’s fishing and surfing OBX, strolling the Battery, tubing the Saluda, or just looking out at Lake Norman. Either way, there’s no denying there’s no place like the Carolinas.

Carolina Brewery is here to celebrate the journey—to share every discovery, every wrong turn, and every crazy story. For each stream, harbor, or road less traveled in your Carolina Life, we’ll be there with a compass, a map, and some truly great beer.


Our BREWPUBS


CHAPEL HILL

Founded in 1995, Carolina Brewery’s Chapel Hill location is the oldest operating craft brewery in the Triangle. Gather your friends and join us for fresh beer, scratch-made food, and weekend brunch in an environment of genuine hospitality.


PITTSBORO

In 2007, Carolina Brewery opened its second restaurant and production brewery in Pittsboro, NC. The restaurant features a huge patio, where we host regular events. Its also where we brew and can our full line-up of beers for retail outlets.


WE LIKE TO SHARE


ADVENTURES + BEER

Follow @CAROLINABREWERY for updates on our adventures throughout the Carolinas

La brasserie propose de la bière fraîche, de la nourriture faite maison, un brunch le week-end, et brasse et met en canette sa gamme complète de bières pour les points de vente au détail. Le texte mentionne également plusieurs lieux dans les Carolines tels que le Nantahala, Masonboro Island, OBX, The Battery, le Saluda et le lac Norman.

About Us

Brian

Growing up in Dallas, Brian never thought he would live in Houston. EVER. However, having been here for over a decade, he has found what makes Houston one of the greatest cities in the world, whether it’s food, people or beer. After joining the Karbach cycling team and realizing how well beer and bikes go together, he decided to plan an epic ride to hit every brewery in the city of Houston in one day. Needless to say, it was a mess. A success, but a mess. Regrouping for a second try with rules set in place for each participant, he realized that this could be done over and over again. That’s when the idea was put forth that other people might like to try it as well but maybe not so extreme. Partnering with his long-time friend, Jason, Tour de Brewery was born in May 2018.

When he’s not riding around town or drinking beer, he can be found on stage in Houston performing improv at ComedySportz or writing sketch comedy and standup.

Tour Guide extraordinaire.

hemophilia. For every parent who goes to bed in
agony not understanding how to treat their child's
disorder. For every hemophiliac athlete who waits
in quiet hesitation out of fear of injury. For all of
us overcoming the impossible. This mountain is
for you."

resultats_lens.texte_contexte: Numéro de juin 2017 du bulletin d'information 'The Clotting Connection' de l'Hemophilia and Thrombosis Center de l'University of Colorado Anschutz Medical Campus, affilié au Children's Hospital Colorado et à l'University of Colorado Hospital. Le bulletin met en avant l'alpiniste et hémophile Chris Bombardier qui a gravi le mont Everest (la sixième des Sept Sommets) tout en gérant son traitement de facteur IX, ainsi que d'autres actualités comme le directeur du HTC Dr. Marilyn Manco-Johnson participant au tour à vélo Ride the Rockies avec Kyle Haas et l'équipe Project ReCycle.
